event: Determine the location of the flame sound (gas stove) relative to a robot standing by the sink and facing the fireplace.

sounding_object.description: A stainless steel gas cooktop with multiple (likely 5 or 6) black burners and black grates. It is built into a white countertop, which is part of a kitchen counter with dark wood cabinets below and a stainless steel range hood above. The specific sounding part is one of the gas burners when it ignites.

reference_object.description: A white, likely porcelain, undermount sink with a modern chrome faucet. It's set into a white countertop on a kitchen island. The robot is considered to be standing by this sink.

facing_object.description: A stone-faced fireplace, constructed with grey, stacked stones, and featuring a wooden mantel. A painting is hung on the wall above the mantel. The robot is considered to be facing this object.

question: Imagine you are a robot standing by the sink with a tap and facing the fireplace, when the flame sound comes up, relative to where you are facing, where is the sounding object: front-left, front-right, back-left, or back-right? The directions refer to the quadrants of a Cartesian plane (if you are standing at the origin and facing along the positive y-axis). Consider the center point location of the object as the its location.
